whatsappMessage:
Hi Team the salon,

I noticed your salon has 76 reviews in the prominent Exhibition Rd area of Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new clients.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, bridal/groom styling services, aur location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/salon

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi the salon team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a showcase of your beauty services right on Exhibition Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual salon photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
